title: Stakeholder management: expectations, priorities and continuous communication

videos.script: Marina's second presentation went well. Paulo approved the pilot in nine minutes, Sandra offered her team, and nobody attacked anything. {{went}} That was not luck. By the time the meeting started, everybody who mattered had already seen the finding. {{seen}} Sandra had seen it alone, a week earlier. Diego had checked the numbers. Renata had the arithmetic. Paulo had read the one-page summary. {{who}} The meeting confirmed decisions that had been prepared in a dozen small conversations. {{small}} This lesson is about those conversations. Who has a stake in your analysis, what each one expects, and how to keep them informed so that nothing lands as a surprise. {{about}}
